label: BiciCAM
description:
Control a DJI Osmo Action from your Karoo: record, stop, battery, card, markers and a red frame while it records.

DJI and Osmo are trademarks of their owners. BiciCAM is not affiliated with or endorsed by DJI or Hammerhead.
releaseNotes: First public version: DJI Osmo Action control, eight data fields, red recording frame, in-ride alerts, English and Spanish. Tested with an Osmo Action 6 in real rides on 13 and 22 November 2026.
